title: Ghost and Contact
author: Casper Delacroix
blurb: Rosalind Marchetti, a whistle-blower living under four names, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
